summary: Frp là một proxy ngược nhanh giúp exposing server cục bộ nằm sau NAT hoặc tường lửa ra internet.
usecases: Exposing local development server to public for testing.
Accessing home network services remotely behind NAT.
Bypassing firewall restrictions for internal tool access.
ideas: Combine with WireGuard for secure P2P-like tunnel.
Use as internal service mesh for micro-frontends.
Deploy as edge proxy for IoT devices behind NAT.
